summary: Steep slip-road kerb under a flyover; clearway and no parked cars.

drivers.seclusion: Garden strip and car park to the west, flyover above; very public.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane adjoins the kerb with no pull-out and no parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Busy through route with flyover ramp and buses.
drivers.convention: Clearway 7am-7pm Mon-Fri; no parked cars seen.

sun_shade: Open, with flyover shade to the north-east and some trees on the west.

best_section.where: Musgrave Road west kerb below the Moggill Road flyover
